MESSAGE FROM DANA:
Plan my exercise for this week around my running goals.

response.text: Got it, Dana! To build the perfect weekly plan, could you share your specific running goal (e.g., a 5K PR, marathon base-building) and your current weekly mileage? Also, let me know which days you prefer to run and if you want cross-training mixed in—once I have that, I'll map out a balanced week for you.
